speaker.jigoku_pilot: Zeon remnant army grunt pilot (serving under Major Yonem Kirks)
speaker.basis: settled 2026-10-02 from fresh-translation review: Zeon remnant veteran (ten years in hiding, Sieg Zeon); no name spoken; Jigoku calls him a grunt under Yonem Kirks, nothing in the lines shows he is Kirks himself

proposed_by_v_mix_03.basis: Zeon remnant veteran (ten years in hiding, Sieg Zeon); no name spoken; Jigoku calls him a grunt under Yonem Kirks, nothing in the lines shows he is Kirks himself

131:19.en: 「Can I do this...? No, I have to!」

131:56.en: 「I've waited so long for this day...!」

131:207.en: 「This wind, this feel... This is war!」

131:244.en: 「$$ジオン$$ can fight for ten more years!」

131:277.en: 「I'll show you how battle is fought!」

131:306.en: 「Anyone in my way is going down!」

131:337.en: 「If I don't get them, they'll get me!」

131:423.en: 「We gave up everything to come here!」

131:497.en: 「Our days in hiding end here today!」

131:536.en: 「All we have left is to fight!」

alternatives: I'll hit you in the power core!
I'll hit your power unit directly!

131:713.en: 「This ammo is precious! I can't miss!」

131:752.en: 「My barrel burns out, or you fall!」
alternatives: Either my barrel melts or you fall!
If I grapple you at close range...!!
Melee combat is won by experience!
I'll show you\nreal MS melee combat!

131:1179.en: 「I'll come at you again and again!」
alternatives: I'll go as often as it takes!
Too slow! Here comes another hit!
A Gundam is still\na mobile suit!

131:1368.en: 「You devil! We meet in battle again!」
alternatives: Devil! We meet again in battle!
Hear our cries of hatred, Gundam!

131:1446.en: 「What can a fake Gundam possibly do!」
alternatives: What can a fake Gundam do!
Break those wings\nand slam you down!

131:1626.en: 「Skill will make up the power gap!」
alternatives: My skill can close the power gap!

131:1661.en: 「We should have the edge in agility!」
alternatives: I should have the edge in agility!

131:1737.en: 「You'd face me in that weak unit...!」
alternatives: Attacking in such a weak machine...!

131:1809.en: 「You and I are dogs of the same war!」
alternatives: You and I are both dogs of war!
Take out their ace and crush morale!

131:1949.en: 「We haven't survived this long\nfor nothing, either!」

131:2002.en: 「Crush their leader, and we can win!」
alternatives: Crush their leader to seize victory!

131:2107.en: 「So young... Your moves give it away!」

alternatives: To some brat with no resolve...!

131:2261.en: 「I won't let you get any cockier!」
alternatives: I won't let you get cockier!

131:2294.en: 「I won't let this chance slip away!」
alternatives: I won't let this chance get away!
I'll finish you with this counter!

131:2356.en: 「I'll repay my debt, no matter what!」
alternatives: I'll repay you, once and for all!

131:2425.en: 「Time to show the soul of $$ジオン$$!」
alternatives: Time to show them Zeon's spirit!
Regroup while I have the chance!

131:2481.en: 「I won't stand by and let you!」
alternatives: I won't let you have your way!

131:2508.en: 「Some glory is only won by living!」
alternatives: Some glory can only be won alive!
If only our numbers were even!
I'll take you down for sure!
If we bring our numbers to bear...!
I'll focus on pinning them down!
Tch! I let the perfect chance slip!

131:2873.en: 「Damn! I'm a sitting duck like this!」

131:2943.en: 「Ngh! Am I finally out of options?!」

alternatives: So I'm out of energy too...!

131:3106.en: 「This machine and I still have it!」
alternatives: We're both still in active service!
Missed...! The tide's turned my way!
The machine's worse, but I'm better!

131:3283.en: 「That's it! I'm not easy to hit!」
alternatives: You won't hit me that easily!

131:3324.en: 「Power means nothing if it can't hit!」
alternatives: Power means nothing if you miss!

131:3361.en: 「A Gundam alone won't make you win!」
alternatives: A Gundam alone won't win this!

131:3503.en: 「A fake is still just a fake!」

131:3532.en: 「GM types are easy prey as ever!」

131:3716.en: 「So you're as weak as you look!」
alternatives: Weak as it looks, after all!

131:3751.en: 「You brat! Run home to your mama!」
alternatives: You brat! Run home to your mommy!

131:3792.en: 「You're too green to be in battle!」

131:3862.en: 「If I can deflect it with this...!」

alternatives: I'll block it with my shield!
I'll block it with the shield!
Can't rely on my shield forever...!
At least my armor stopped it...!
Doesn't look like much of an enemy!

131:4122.en: 「A scratch or two means nothing now!」

alternatives: That attack won't stop my charge!

131:4198.en: 「Cheap tricks are all you're good at!」
alternatives: You're only skilled at cheap tricks!

131:4386.en: 「Old model or not, I can still...!」
alternatives: Old model or not, I still...!

131:4413.en: 「Damn you! Don't think this is over!」

alternatives: Can't keep taking hits like this...!
As feared,\nthe power gap's too wide!

131:4548.en: 「A moment later and I'd be dead...!」
alternatives: Any slower and I'd be dead...!
This one's bold...! A tough foe!
My controls haven't been hit yet!
Damn it! I'm no stepping stone!
This is the White Devil, or worse!
So strong...! A true latest model!

131:4923.en: 「I can't even beat a fake Gundam?!」
alternatives: I can't even beat a fake Gundam!?

131:5052.en: 「C-could that one...!\nBe a $$ニュータイプ$$?!」

alternatives: I can't keep up...!\nCould it be...!?

131:5162.en: 「No! That sheer power will crush me!」

131:5203.en: 「Ngh! That speed is too much for me!」
alternatives: Ngh! I can't match that speed!
I dismissed it as small, and now...!
Power and drive... Is this youth!?
Whoa!? Is that thing a monster!?

131:5431.en: 「N-no! I won't let you! I won't!」
alternatives: I-I won't let you! I won't!

131:5642.en: 「If it comes to it, I'll ram you!」
alternatives: If need be, I'll die in a charge!

131:5681.en: 「If I run, my ten years mean nothing!」
alternatives: Retreat would waste my ten years!

131:5724.en: 「As long as it moves, I'll fight on!」

131:5763.en: 「My machine and I are worn...! But!」

131:5802.en: 「No retreat! I'll fight to the end!」

131:5928.en: 「Looks like I won't make it back...」

131:5986.en: 「I-is this as far as I go?!」
alternatives: I-Is this as far as I go!?
